questions.question: Who initiated the Java language project, and what was the language initially called?

required_facts.fact: Java language project was initiated by James Gosling, Mike Sheridan, and Patrick Naughton in June 1991
The language was initially called Oak

questions.question: Which Java versions are supported as long-term support releases?

required_facts.fact: Java 8, 11, 17, 21, and 25 are supported as long-term support (LTS) versions (as of June 2026)

questions.question: Which companies does the Oracle implementation of Java target, and what acquisition made Oracle the owner of the official Java SE implementation?

required_facts.fact: Oracle Corporation owns the official implementation of the Java SE platform due to its acquisition of Sun Microsystems on January 27, 2010

questions.question: Who rewrote the PHP parser in 1997, forming the base of PHP 3?

required_facts.fact: Zeev Suraski and Andi Gutmans rewrote the parser in 1997 and formed the base of PHP 3

questions.question: What is the mascot of the PHP project, and who designed it?

required_facts.fact: The mascot is the elePHPant, a blue elephant with the PHP logo on its side
The elePHPant was designed by Vincent Pontier in 1998

questions.question: On what date was PHP 8.0 released?
In Rust, how does a programmer declare a variable that can be modified after creation?

required_facts.fact: Variables are immutable by default unless the mut keyword is added

questions.question: Does Rust rely on garbage collection for memory management?

required_facts.fact: Rust does not use garbage collection; memory is managed through resource acquisition is initialization (RAII) with optional reference counting / ownership

questions.question: What is the name of Rust's build system and package manager?

required_facts.fact: Cargo is Rust's build system and package manager

questions.question: Who created the Swift programming language, and when was it first released?

required_facts.fact: Swift was created by Chris Lattner in 2010 for Apple Inc.
Swift was first released in June 2014

questions.question: Which automatic mechanism does Swift use to manage memory instead of tracing garbage collection?

required_facts.fact: Swift uses Automatic Reference Counting (ARC) to manage memory, removing the need for a garbage collector
